title: Interest Reinstated on the Correct Part of a Duplicate-Posting Dispute — Northgate Card
content:
Where a duplicate-posting dispute about a Northgate order on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account is settled for the cardholder and part of the disputed amount proves correct, interest on that correct part is reinstated, and the amount reinstated is taken away from what the settlement credits.

**Correct part.** The correct part of the dispute is the disputed amount less the duplicate excess, and never less than zero. The duplicate excess is the amount by which the purchase postings carrying the order's reference exceed what the order record charged, never less than zero.

**Reinstated interest.** The interest reinstated on the correct part is set by the most recent statement on the account (the statement with the latest closing date):

- where the correct part is above zero and that statement charged purchase interest, it is the correct part times the tier's purchase APR divided by 100 and by 365, times the days from the notice date through that statement's closing date, both counted, with no days when the notice came after that closing date, rounded half up to the cent;
- where the correct part is above zero and that statement charged no purchase interest but a minimum interest charge, it is the tier's minimum interest charge;
- in every other case it is nothing.

| Correct part | Most recent statement charged | Interest reinstated |
|---|---|---|
| above zero | purchase interest | correct part at the daily rate for the days from the notice date through its closing date |
| above zero | no purchase interest, a minimum interest charge | the tier's minimum interest charge |
| above zero | neither | nothing |
| zero | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical worked figures (rate chosen for round arithmetic)

Correct part 36.50 on a tier with a 29.99% purchase APR; the notice was received on the 3rd and the most recent statement, which charged purchase interest, closed on the 12th of the same month: the days run from the 3rd through the 12th, 10 days; 36.50 times 0.2999 divided by 365, times 10, is 0.2999, reinstated as 0.30. Had the notice come on the 13th, after that closing date, there would be no days and nothing reinstated. Had the most recent statement charged only a minimum interest charge, the tier's minimum interest charge would be reinstated (2.00 on every Northgate Card).
